title: Recombee - Domain-flexible AI recommendation engine (Recommender as a Service)
clean_text: Recombee is a Recommender-as-a-Service platform combining collaborative filtering, content-based filtering, and knowledge-based systems through a RESTful API and SDKs designed by data scientists. Unlike ecommerce-specific competitors, Recombee is domain-flexible, having been used to recommend music, movies, books, news, cultural events, job listings, and ecommerce products. Includes ReQL, a proprietary filtering and boosting query language for fine-grained recommendation customization, and addresses the cold-start problem through automated content-based models. Founded by a team including four PhD holders with strong academic research ties. Targets developers and businesses wanting deep customization across varied content domains rather than a plug-and-play ecommerce widget.

meta.target: developers, businesses needing custom recommendation logic
